goal: Open a new development generation for MFI-Edge using only development-authorized data. Explain and improve contextual fuzzy control of Scharr+NMS through interpretable mechanisms, then freeze a new generation before any future untouched external test.
success_criteria: All Stage-14 architecture selection, feature selection, thresholds, and hyperparameters use only synthetic development sets and UDED selection with leakage-free repeated CV, or a future split explicitly designated as development before inspection.
At least three mechanistically distinct hypotheses are considered at the research checkpoint, with exactly one minimal falsification experiment registered at a time.

Candidate directions include the already implemented d-Choquet/d-CF/d-XC/d-CC RDF family, analysis/ablation of relative positive-vs-negative contextual control, and conditional/mixture-of-experts routing only when complementarity is demonstrated on development data.
Feature and mechanism ablations are used to prune redundant components before any larger combination model is attempted.
A new model generation is frozen only after repeated leakage-free development evidence is stable; BSDS500 test, BIPEDv2 test, and UDED held-out remain unavailable for tuning or model selection.
A future external validation is performed only on a genuinely untouched dataset/protocol reserved before observing its labels/results.

development_confirmation_only: UDED held-out (historically inspected; do not optimize on it)
optimization_policy.rule: Never choose or alter hyperparameters, descriptors, thresholds, operator choices, architecture, or experiment priority from external/final test outcomes. External results may be documented but are not an optimization signal.

autonomy_policy.normal_mode: Use low reasoning and repository-local evidence to interpret a completed development experiment and prepare exactly one next allow-listed experiment.
autonomy_policy.research_escalation: Use medium reasoning plus live web search when available at research-planning checkpoints, after contradictory development evidence, or after repeated stagnation.
autonomy_policy.stagnation_rule: After three consecutive failed development hypotheses from the same mechanism family, stop micro-tuning that family and research a mechanistically different direction.
autonomy_policy.one_change_rule: Prefer one interpretable mechanism change per iteration and the smallest valid falsification experiment.
autonomy_policy.combination_rule: Do not build a large ensemble by default. First prune models/features; combine surviving mechanisms only if development-only ablations show complementary errors or regime-specific benefit.

stage14_initial_questions: Do RDF-based d-Choquet/d-CF/d-XC/d-CC operators improve robustness of the multiscale signature under blur, noise, texture, or scale heterogeneity?
Does relative positive-vs-negative contextual evidence provide a reproducible development-only advantage over positive-only and separable bi-capacity controls, and which terms are essential?
Are there identifiable regimes where distinct fuzzy controllers are complementary enough to justify a small interpretable conditional expert model?
